correctness.rationale: Determinant and trace give C_c PSD with rank one at zero; the adjugate gives the exact three-measure formula, checked in four exact rational examples. A geometric-gamma construction proves absolute continuity for c>0 and singular exponential-curve support at zero. Exponential smoothing yields exact variation bounds O(sqrt(c)) from second moments 2dc/e and 2ec/d. Mutual singularity yields the leading coefficient 2(d/a+e/b); rational moments and polynomial density prove weak continuity. Every hypothesis and normalization appears explicitly in RESULT.md; finite checks are supplementary.
